# Pattern Quality Checklist

Use this checklist to ensure patterns meet quality standards before submission and approval.
page_texts.3:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#content-completeness]

### Content Completeness

- [ ] Pattern metadata is complete and accurate
- [ ] Pattern ID follows three-level convention: `PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###}`
- [ ] Pattern ID is unique within the subsection
- [ ] Pattern ID matches filename
- [ ] Domain is one of the eight official domains
- [ ] Subsection matches directory structure
- [ ] Executive summary clearly articulates problem and solution
- [ ] Context and problem sections provide sufficient background
- [ ] Solution description is detailed and comprehensive
- [ ] Implementation guidelines are actionable and complete
- [ ] All required sections are present and populated
- [ ] Examples demonstrate real-world application
page_texts.4:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#technical-accuracy]

### Technical Accuracy

- [ ] Pattern addresses a real, recurring problem
- [ ] Solution is technically sound and feasible
- [ ] Implementation steps are correct and complete
- [ ] Code examples are syntactically correct
- [ ] Configuration examples are valid
- [ ] Dependencies and prerequisites are accurate
- [ ] Healthcare-specific considerations addressed (HIPAA, FHIR, Medicaid)
page_texts.5:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#documentation-quality]

### Documentation Quality

- [ ] Writing is clear, concise, and professional
- [ ] Document follows markdown formatting standards
- [ ] Architecture diagrams are clear and well-labeled
- [ ] Images and diagrams are high quality
- [ ] Links and references are working and accurate
- [ ] File naming follows three-level conventions
- [ ] Navigation breadcrumbs included at top
- [ ] Standard footer included: `{!includes/common-footer.md!}`
page_texts.6:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#standards-and-architecture-alignment]

### Standards and Architecture Alignment

- [ ] Pattern aligns with enterprise architecture principles
- [ ] Pattern aligns with Enterprise Architecture Practice Overview domains
- [ ] Related standards are referenced with correct IDs (STD-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN})
- [ ] Related patterns are referenced with correct IDs (PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###})
- [ ] Related guidance is referenced with correct IDs (GUID-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) if applicable
- [ ] Related best practices are referenced with correct IDs (BP-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) if applicable
- [ ] Related reference architectures are referenced with correct IDs (REF-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) if applicable
- [ ] Governance and compliance requirements are addressed
- [ ] Pattern fits within established domain and subsection structure
- [ ] Cross-references use correct format for each artifact type
page_texts.8:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#technical-review]

### Technical Review

- [ ] Pattern solves the stated problem effectively

- [ ] Best practices are incorporated
- [ ] Common pitfalls are identified and addressed
- [ ] Performance and scalability considerations are covered
- [ ] Security implications are addressed
- [ ] Healthcare compliance requirements considered

- [ ] Success criteria are measurable
- [ ] Benefits and trade-offs are clearly explained

page_texts.19:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#completeness-review]

### Completeness Review

- [ ] All template sections are completed appropriately
- [ ] Related patterns referenced using correct IDs (PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###})
- [ ] Related standards referenced using correct IDs (STD-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN})
- [ ] Related guidance referenced using correct IDs (GUID-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) if applicable
- [ ] Related best practices referenced using correct IDs (BP-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) if applicable
- [ ] Related reference architectures referenced using correct IDs (REF-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}) if applicable
- [ ] Dependencies are identified with correct artifact IDs
- [ ] External references are relevant and current
- [ ] Change history section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] Initial change history entry documents pattern creation
- [ ] Review log section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] All completed reviews are documented in review log
- [ ] Subsection README.md updated with new pattern
- [ ] Domain README.md reflects correct pattern count (if applicable)
- [ ] Cross-references in related patterns updated
page_texts.21:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#strategic-alignment]

### Strategic Alignment

- [ ] Pattern supports organizational architecture strategy
- [ ] Pattern is consistent with technology roadmap
- [ ] Business value and benefits are clear
- [ ] Pattern promotes architectural consistency
page_texts.22:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#governance-compliance]

### Governance Compliance

- [ ] Pattern follows established governance processes
- [ ] Appropriate approvals and reviews are completed
- [ ] Compliance requirements are addressed

page_texts.23:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#organizational-impact]

### Organizational Impact

- [ ] Pattern adoption strategy is considered
- [ ] Training and support needs are identified

page_texts.25:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#final-quality-assurance]

### Final Quality Assurance

- [ ] All reviewer feedback has been addressed
- [ ] Pattern status is updated to "approved"
- [ ] Document is properly formatted and polished
- [ ] Pattern is added to subsection README.md with clickable link
- [ ] Pattern ID is bold and linked in README table
- [ ] Domain README.md is updated (if needed)
- [ ] Communication plan is executed
page_texts.26:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#accessibility-and-discovery]

### Accessibility and Discovery

- [ ] Pattern is properly tagged and categorized
- [ ] Three-level pattern ID is correct and unique
- [ ] Pattern is in correct domain/subsection directory
- [ ] Pattern is linked from related patterns with correct ID
- [ ] Cross-references throughout repository are updated
- [ ] Training materials are available if needed
- [ ] Standard footer is included
page_texts.28:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#relevance-review]

### Relevance Review

- [ ] Pattern is still relevant and useful
- [ ] Technology dependencies are current
- [ ] Implementation examples are up-to-date
- [ ] Success metrics are being achieved
page_texts.29:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#usage-assessment]

### Usage Assessment

- [ ] Pattern adoption rate is acceptable
- [ ] Feedback from implementations is positive

page_texts.30:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#update-requirements]

### Update Requirements

- [ ] Content accuracy is verified
- [ ] New examples or use cases are added
- [ ] Change history is updated with all modifications
- [ ] Review log is updated with current review
- [ ] Related patterns are still relevant
- [ ] Pattern IDs and cross-references are correct
- [ ] Three-level naming convention maintained
page_texts.32:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#pattern-id-validation]

### Pattern ID Validation

- [ ] Pattern ID format: `PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###}`
- [ ] Domain code is correct (APP, INFRA, SEC, TEC, INF, OPS, BIZ, GOV)
- [ ] Subsection code is appropriate (API, EVT, K8S, MFE, MTN)
- [ ] Sequential number is unique within subsection
- [ ] Pattern ID matches filename
- [ ] Pattern ID matches metadata `pattern_id` field
page_texts.33:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#file-and-directory-structure]

### File and Directory Structure

- [ ] File in correct domain directory
- [ ] File in correct subsection directory
- [ ] Filename format: `PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###}-descriptive-name-pattern.md`
- [ ] Descriptive name is lowercase with hyphens
- [ ] File ends with `-pattern.md`
page_texts.34:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#cross-reference-validation]

### Cross-Reference Validation

- [ ] All pattern references use correct format: `PTN-{DOMAIN}-{SUBSECTION}-{###}`
- [ ] All standard references use correct format: `STD-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
- [ ] All guidance references use correct format: `GUID-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
- [ ] All best practice references use correct format: `BP-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
- [ ] All reference architecture references use correct format: `REF-{DOMAIN}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
- [ ] All links to patterns and other artifacts are correct
- [ ] Subsection README.md includes pattern with clickable ID
- [ ] Related patterns section uses correct IDs for all artifact types
- [ ] No references to old two-level pattern IDs remain

page_texts.40:
[patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md#quality-metrics]

## Quality Metrics

Track these metrics to ensure pattern quality:

- **Review Completion Rate**: Percentage of patterns completing full review process
- **Implementation Success Rate**: Success rate of pattern implementations
- **User Satisfaction**: Feedback scores from pattern users
- **Defect Rate**: Number of issues found in published patterns
- **Update Frequency**: How often patterns require updates
- **Adoption Rate**: Usage levels across the organization

- Usage analytics and metrics
